verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a database product, since managed database consoles can ship one, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows external agents working with Chroma: an MCP server for Claude, and a setup prompt to paste into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Neither is an assistant built into Chroma itself, so they are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
